policy.qualifies: a published GitHub release tag vX.Y.Z of the configured archive repository whose manifest.json (schema 1.0) at that tag validates; draft and prerelease releases are structurally excluded
policy.recheck: claims are re-derived at rebuild: asset bytes hashed against registered digests and SHA256SUMS; manifest fingerprints compared with pinned-commit bytes; DOI registration cross-checked via the Zenodo API; release prose is never rendered
policy.last_known_good: the whole update is held (previous snapshot stays deployed) unless EVERY rebuilt record is independently verified: any previously verified record re-deriving degraded holds even when its upstream data changed, and any new record that is not fully verified holds; failed, unreachable and removed-record rebuilds never publish
policy.refresh: scheduled GitHub Actions workflow on the site repository; also runnable manually via workflow_dispatch
